hostname rt-q01
!
vrf definition cust-a
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
 lifetime 28800
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-name hostname ix-q09.example.com
!
crypto keyring KR-Virtual-Template1
 pre-shared-key address 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 key dummy-psk-sample-vt
crypto isakmp profile ISAKMP-Virtual-Template1
 keyring KR-Virtual-Template1
 match identity address 0.0.0.0
 virtual-template 1
!
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-PROP
 encryption aes-cbc-256
 integrity sha256
 group 14
!
crypto ikev2 policy IKEV2-POL
 proposal IKEV2-PROP
!
crypto ikev2 keyring IKEV2-KEYS
 peer Tunnel2
  address 203.0.113.40
  pre-shared-key dummy-psk-sample-c
!
crypto ikev2 profile IKEV2-Tunnel2
 match identity remote address 203.0.113.40 255.255.255.255
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local IKEV2-KEYS
 lifetime 86400
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Virtual-Template1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel2 esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Virtual-Template1
 set transform-set TS-Virtual-Template1
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel1
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel2
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel2
 set security-association lifetime seconds 28800
 set ikev2-profile IKEV2-Tunnel2
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample-wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.248
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-lan
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description sample-lan-cust-a
 vrf forwarding cust-a
 ip address 192.0.2.129 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel destination ix-q09.example.com
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel2
 vrf forwarding cust-a
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/2
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.40
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel2
 no shutdown
!
interface Virtual-Template1 type tunnel
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Virtual-Template1
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.14 1
ip route 198.51.100.128 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1 1
ip route vrf cust-a 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.128 Tunnel2 1
!
end
